article.title: Perform.AI免費檢查網店UCP及ACP準備度，評分採固定規則
article.title_en: Perform.AI offers fixed-rule UCP and ACP readiness checks for online stores
article.summary: Perform.AI在11月18日推出免費網店檢查器，排查AI購物代理發現產品、結帳及售後介面的缺漏。
article.summary_en: Perform.AI launched a free checker on November 18 for gaps in AI shopping discovery, checkout and post-purchase interfaces.
highlights: 147項檢查按網店使用的協定評分，涵蓋發現、購買、售後及系統連接。
評分採固定規則，沒有使用LLM或AI代理；完整報告需工作資料。
highlights_en: 147 checks score the store's protocol across discovery, buying, post-purchase and connections.
Scoring uses fixed rules without an LLM or AI agent; full reports require work details.
article.why: 代理商務準備工作可拆成具體介面缺漏，電商營運可先決定修復產品可讀性、結帳或售後狀態的哪一段。
article.why_en: A diagnostic breakdown helps commerce teams prioritize product readability, checkout or order-status gaps before agent-commerce work.
article.next_step: 先用網店網址取得分數，按發現、結帳及售後把缺漏交予負責人，修復後重跑同一檢查；另行驗證實際購物流程。
article.next_step_en: Score a store URL, assign discovery, checkout and post-purchase gaps, then rerun after fixes and separately validate an actual shopping journey.
article.detail: UCP與ACP是讓購物代理與店面互通的協定。這次檢查器本身以固定規則計算分數，不能把產品名稱中的AI寫成自主代理實測。公司稱毋須安裝或提供系統存取權；完整報告會要求姓名、公司及工作電郵。編輯建議把分數當作排查清單，分開記錄修復項目及真正交易驗收，避免把滿分誤當成官方認證或所有代理均能購買。
article.detail_en: UCP and ACP are protocols connecting shopping agents with stores. The checker itself applies fixed rules, so it is not an autonomous-agent trial. The issuer says no installation or system access is required; full reports request name, company and work email. Treat scores as diagnostics, not certification or proof that every agent can buy.
